Frequently asked questions

What technologies do you work with?

We work with modern stacks including React, Next.js, Astro, Node.js, Python, TypeScript, cloud platforms (AWS, Cloudflare), and more.

Do you build mobile apps?

Yes. We develop native mobile apps for iOS and Android as well as cross-platform solutions.

What is your development process?

We follow an agile process with discovery, architecture, development, testing, and deployment phases — with regular client check-ins throughout.

Do you provide ongoing support after launch?

Yes. We offer post-launch support, maintenance, and continuous improvement services.
